title: Petition of the Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 75C for the right to exercise the power of eminent domain under c. 79 of the G.L. for the right to take by eminent domain such rights of way, permanent easements, temporary easements or such other interests in land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, , alteration and/or removal of natural gas transmission pipeline appliances, appurtenances and other equipment situated in the Towns of Stockbridge and Lee in the County of Berkshire.
